votes.motion: Re-approval of Resolution #2021-50, the Micron East Annexation of 111.51-acres located at 1800 East 4800 North with TH-5 zoning.

Consideration of Resolution #2021-56, approving an agreement with Blalock and Partners for architectural and engineering services for the construction of Fire Station 84. Chief Craft presented information on the building of Station 84.

Consideration of Resolution #2021-55, regarding an application to the Bureau of Reclamation for a WaterSMART Grant for Fiscal Year 2022. Andy Gowan presented information on the Water Smart grant. He stated the grant was not granted. They met with the committee to meet the steps to be able to get approval for grant

Consideration of Resolution #2021-57, beginning the process of adjusting the municipal boundaries between Lehi City and Draper City on 163.03 acres of property located at approximately 4600 North and 1200 East. The applicant was not present. Kim Struthers explained the process of the boundary adjustment

Consideration of Resolution #2021-58, approval of Intent to Annex the Neldon and Jewel Bullock Annexation, 0.67-acres of property located at 578 West 2100 North with proposed R-1-15 zoning. Jewel Bullock addressed the Council about annexation her property to Lehi City. The Council

Consideration of Final subdivision approval for Gardner Point Phase 2, a 94-unit residential development located at 4100 West 1500 North. Jed Stewart with Edge Homes was present to represent the applicant.

Councilor Koivisto moved to table consideration of X Development Ordinance                 #56-2021, approving a zone change from A-5 (agriculture) to Neighborhood                 Commercial and R-1-Flex (residential) on 20.10-acres of property located at 2100                 North 2300 West. (Tabled from August 10, 2021 City Council Meeting); including                 any Development Review Committee comments.
Consideration of Concept approval for the 2100 North subdivision, a 66-lot development located at 2100 North 2300 West. Items 10 and 11 were heard simultaneously.

Consideration of Ordinance #57-2021, approving a zone change for various Lehi City owned properties, changing the zoning to Public Facility. Kim Struthers presented information on the requested zone change for the public facilities.
Consideration of Ordinance #58-2021, approving a comprehensive update to the Land Use Element of the General Plan including the land use map and text.
